html:
Question 15
?

The function S(t) gives the area, in squared centimeters, of a thin sheet of ice as it melts t minutes after observations start. What is the best interpretation of S′(5)=−7?

a
5 minutes after the observations began, the area of the sheet decreases at a rate of 7 squared centimeters per minute
b
7 minutes after the observation began, the area of the sheet increases at a rate of 5 squared centimeters per minute
c
7 minutes after the observations began, the area of the sheet is 5 squared centimeters
d
During the first 5 minutes of the observations, the area has constantly decreased at a rate of 7 squared centimeters per minute
e
5 minutes after the observations began, the area of the sheet is 7 squared centimeters
